audit.whatIsWrong: The chart (Yorick/Skill/Singed/Singed/Yorick/Singed/Singed) contradicts its own prose in two places. It hands Level 6 to Yorick while every paragraph calls level 6 'your real lane-flip moment', and it hands the 2+ item stage to Singed while the same page says 'don't take extended 1v1s once he has two items' and 'he wins the extended 1v1'.
audit.why: Level 6 is where Insanity Potion's move speed and MR stop the ghoul pack pinning you and Eulogy of the Isles is still a 160-second cooldown at rank 1. Two items later Maiden plus a full Walker pack genuinely out-attritions poison. The packet chart has both the right way round.
audit.corrected: Yorick / Yorick / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Yorick.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites is missing from the entire page — every spike, want, why and paragraph. It is Yorick's Q: a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s auto-attack reset that heals him and digs the grave that becomes a Mist Walker.
audit.why: It is simultaneously his burst tell, his sustain, and the engine of the ghoul army the page is otherwise entirely about. The itemization block already says 'anti-heal early — his healing fights your pattern' without ever naming the heal it is buying against.
audit.corrected: Spikes: Yorick lvl 1-2 (Last Rites graves and the early shove), Dark Procession at 20s from level 3, Eulogy of the Isles at 6 (160/130/100s); Singed lvl 6 Insanity Potion — which applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail and is the direct answer to Last Rites — then Rylai's, then concede the 2-item duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) whys[0] says Mourning Mist 'gives instant slow and root on exit'. It does not root. Riot's text: it reduces armour, damages, slows and marks — and summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets. The speed is on his ghouls, not a root on you. (2) wants.foe[0] calls it 'his E mist-cage'; the cage is Dark Procession (W), a different ability. (3) late claims 'his ghouls inherit Maiden's damage scaling' — that is not in Riot's description of Eulogy of the Isles, which says Yorick's own attacks against the Maiden's target deal bonus damage and the Maiden raises Walkers from dead enemies.
audit.why: A phantom root changes whether you can walk out of a fight. Merging E and W into one 'cage' hides that the cage has a separate 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown and, crucially, is destructible. And an invented scaling makes the reader time a spike that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist is a 700-range projectile on 12/11/10/9/8s: armour shred, damage, slow, and a mark that speeds his Walkers toward you — no root. Dark Procession is the cage, 600 range on 20/18/16/14/12s, and it is a destructible wall — you can attack it down rather than walking around it. Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s and gives Yorick bonus damage against whatever the Maiden is attacking. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds applies through Poison Trail and directly fights Last Rites' heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is named as the tracked cooldown everywhere but never numbered, and Eulogy of the Isles never appears with a duration.
audit.why: 20 seconds at rank 1 is a short leash, and 160 seconds on his ultimate at rank 1 is the single largest window in the matchup — that is the proxy window and it should be stated.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession 20/18/16/14/12s. Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s — at rank 1 that is nearly three minutes with no Maiden.

edits.before: You lose levels 1-2 outright — Yorick's first ghoul from the wave and his E mark let him all-in you before you can build any kite angle, and your Poison Trail alone doesn't keep pace with his burst. Don't contest the wave early: proxy under his tower or behind his wave to deny him the ghoul stacks he needs. The moment he marks you with E and his ghouls are up, disengage hard — running into his mist slows you and sets up a Dark Procession wall that removes Fling as an escape. If you're forced to trade, bait him inside your poison cloud and immediately run perpendicular so his ghouls overshoot; even at level 3 with Mega Adhesive you're not winning the prolonged fight, you're buying time.
edits.after: You lose levels 1-2 outright — Last Rites is a 6-second auto-reset that heals him and digs the grave every Walker comes from, so his burst and his sustain are the same button. Don't contest the wave early: proxy under his tower or behind his wave to deny him graves. The moment Mourning Mist marks you, disengage hard — it shreds your armour, slows you, and speeds every Walker toward you. Dark Procession then walls the exit. If forced to trade, bait him into your poison cloud and run perpendicular so his ghouls overshoot; even at level 3 with Mega Adhesive you are buying time, not winning the prolonged fight. Take the CS you can reach from trail range and let the wave push at you.

edits.before: Level 6 with Insanity Potion is your real lane-flip moment. The movement speed and magic resist mean his ghouls can no longer reliably pin you, and Maiden becomes your primary target rather than a threat to dodge — fling Yorick away from Maiden every time he tries to stack ghouls inside her aura, and run your Poison Trail in tight circles through the ghoul clump to dissolve it. The proxy pattern now punishes Yorick badly: if he follows you behind the wave, he abandons Maiden to your turret; if he farms normally, you're banking gold and forcing him off the map. His Dark Procession wall is the one ability that can still punish you at 6, so never run directly away from him — angle sideways through your Mega Adhesive goo so the wall lands behind you rather than in front.
edits.after: Level 6 with Insanity Potion is your real lane-flip moment, and it does double duty: the stats stop the Walkers pinning you, and the Grievous Wounds it puts on Poison Trail cuts Last Rites' heal every time he resets an auto. Fling Yorick away from Maiden whenever he stacks ghouls inside her aura, and run Poison Trail in tight circles through the clump to dissolve it. The proxy now punishes him badly: follow you and he abandons Maiden to your turret; farm normally and he bleeds the map. Dark Procession is the one ability that still catches you — it is destructible, so hit it down rather than panicking, and angle sideways through your own goo so it lands behind you rather than across your exit. Never run in a straight line away from a Yorick who still has the wall up.

edits.before: Rylai's spike is your peak carry window — a slowed Yorick inside your Poison Trail cannot position Maiden or Dark Procession reliably, and you can fling him in any direction you choose. Keep proxy pressure forcing him to react. At two-plus items the Maiden + full ghoul army reaches critical mass: even a fully slowed Yorick can sustain through your attrition long enough for the swarm to kill you, and his ghouls inherit Maiden's damage scaling that outraces your second-item power. Don't take extended 1v1s once he has two items; instead, force him to choose between chasing you in the river and protecting his side-lane turrets from your ghost-ult proxy — that resource war is where Singed closes out FAVOURED games.
edits.after: Rylai's spike is your peak carry window — a slowed Yorick inside your Poison Trail cannot position Maiden or Dark Procession reliably, and you can fling him in any direction you choose. Keep proxy pressure forcing him to react, and hold that window: Eulogy of the Isles is 160 seconds at rank 1, so a Maiden that dies is gone for most of a wave cycle. At two-plus items the Maiden and a full Walker pack reach critical mass, and Last Rites keeps healing him through the attrition unless your Grievous Wounds is on him. Don't take extended 1v1s there; force him to choose between chasing you and defending his side-lane turrets — that resource war is where Singed closes out FAVOURED games.

edits.after: Fling is up but the goo is not, and Last Rites resets his auto every 6s while healing him. Give the wave.

notes: All 3 suspectNames are false positives (Poison Trail, Dark Procession, Insanity Potion are correct names). yorick.json's derived flags tag Mourning Mist (E) with 'dash'. Riot's description has no dash in it — it is a thrown globule that marks and speeds his summoned units — so per the standing rule I trusted the description and wrote no dash or grounding-denies-his-E claim. Worth a parser look. Also unresolved and deliberately left out of the page: whether Dark Procession's wall stops a Fling displacement mid-flight. That would be a big deal for the escape advice and I could not verify it from the kits.
